Every screen a buyer can reach on kelstonway.com, with a picture of the page and every line of text on it. This is the site exactly as it stands today (July 28, 2026). It is paused / not public — nobody outside can see it right now.

How to use this
  1. Look at the picture of each page — that's what a buyer sees.
  2. Under it, the left column is the wording that's on the site now. The right column is yours to type in — click it and rewrite anything you want changed.
  3. Every section has a notes box at the bottom for anything that isn't wording — layout, missing pages, questions, "this feels wrong."
  4. When you're done, hit Copy all my edits at the top. It collects only what you changed. Paste that back to Samuel (board message, text, email — anything).
Your typing is saved in this browser as you go, so you can close it and come back. Just don't move the file to another computer mid-review.
Your July 28 handoff is already logged — this doc doesn't replace it.
The four-part copy handoff you sent (wholesale positioning, Meet the Team with all three of you as Partner, delivery-claim removals, factual constraints) is captured and not built yet. So you'll still see the old wording below — "delivered fresh to your door," "across the state," the CEO/COO/CFO titles. Don't re-type all of that here unless you want to change what you already sent. This doc's job is to show you everything else you hadn't seen yet: the order flow, the checkout page, the account pages, the confirmation screens, and the emails.

The badge question you raised: those three badges come straight off the grade we set in Structure — grade 1 Can Hold, grade 2 Ship Soon, grade 3 Order Soon. They describe how ready the plant is, not how much stock is left. Tell me what those three should say to a buyer.
Prices are per tray everywhere on the buyer side ($8.99/tray, not per pot). Flag it if that's wrong for how we'll actually quote.

awaiting your confirmation / Note from Kelston Way / Your Order, As Proposed / Accept This Change / Decline and Keep My Order
Message box on that pageSend Us a Message · "Type your message…" · Send Message

Send Us a Message / Type your message… / If you have a question about your order, reply to the email or contact us directly.
What "Decline and Keep My Order" actually does: when we change a buyer's order (short on an item, swapped size, price fix), they get a link. Accept applies our version and confirms the order. Decline throws out our change and leaves the order exactly as they first sent it — it does not cancel. If those two buttons could be misread, rename them here.
